description: Look up one NFT on Base by contract and token ID: ERC-721 or ERC-1155, current owner (wallet or contract), collection name and symbol, and its metadata: name, description, image link, animation, traits. Reads ipfs://, ar://, https and inline on-chain metadata. Pass owner to confirm a wallet holds it (and its ERC-1155 balance). Read-only. Not charged for invalid input, tokens that don't exist, or when Base can't be reached. Paid via x402; see list_prices.

includeImage.description: Optional: return inline on-chain images up to 100 KB (default: summary only).

owner.description: Optional: a wallet to check ownership for.

name: nft_lookup
title: NFT lookup on Base: current owner, collection, and metadata (name, image, traits)
